scope: Separate equal-looking time coordinates by evidence role so visualization/export evidence cannot silently become PDE or public-correspondence evidence.
truth_boundary: The [0.25,0.75] PDE window is an autonomous preregistration choice, not a recovered OpenAI source parameter.
The callable velocity domain may numerically match the PDE window while remaining a separate delivery scope.
Reference visualization times are autonomous diagnostics and do not constitute PDE validation samples.
A stable animation or snapshot sequence does not verify correspondence to unknown public frame times.
PDE failure does not by itself prohibit saving or displaying a callable velocity field.
